nodes.name: ComfyUI Alive?
nodes.notes: neverError + fullResponse so a dead server yields a status code instead of failing the run.

nodes.name: Start ComfyUI
nodes.notes: Watchdog: relaunches the server whenever the health check fails.

nodes.name: Render Clip
nodes.notes: Blocks for the whole render: ~17 min at 576x1024, ~85 min at 768x1344. Workflow timeout must be off.

nodes.name: Cooldown After Failure
nodes.notes: Failed render loops back to the health check, which restarts the server if it died.

nodes.name: Stitch Episode 1
nodes.notes: Runs once the job list is exhausted. Skips harmlessly if Ep1 clips are incomplete.
